# Global chip market stays in severe supply squeeze, prices climbing fast  
**Bottom line:** Supply risk stays severe (78.7) and price trend remains at a “rising fast” 94.3, leaving little room for price concessions this week.  

## What changed
- Supply risk unchanged at 78.7, price trend unchanged at 94.3; confidence high at 84.6%【1】.  
- Producer price momentum drives both supply tightness and price rise: Semiconductor PPI +9.1% annualized over the last three months【1】.  
- Trade‑press tone remains strongly bullish for price (14 stories, net up +1.0) and supply (78 stories, net tightening +0.91)【2】.  
- Industry demand surges: global chip sales $159.7 B in Aug 2026, +146.1% YoY, pushing both supply strain and price pressure【3】.  
- TSMC foundry loading up 50.9% YoY (vs typical 32.0%), adding to the supply squeeze【4】.

- Processors & advanced logic – supply 76.9 (Severe, ↔), price 83.8 (Rising fast), confidence High.

- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 70.4 (Elevated, ↔), price 90.6 (Rising fast), confidence High.  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **W25Q128JVSIQ** (memory) – supply risk 86.2, 52‑week lead time vs ~12‑week norm.

- **10M08SAE144C8G** (logic) – supply risk 84.9, 52‑week lead time; price 129% above target.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** (logic) – supply risk 84.9, 52‑week lead time; price 60% above target.  

## Outlook
- 66% probability chip prices rise in the next 3 months (expected +2.2%, 80% range –9.6% to +13.9%); forecast has a tested edge【outlook】.  
- 52% probability prices rise in the next 6 months (expected +4.3%, 80% range –8.8% to +17.5%); baseline trend‑following model【outlook】.  
- 63% probability fab utilization tightens in 3 months (expected +1.8 pts, 80% range –1.7 to +5.4) – baseline【outlook】.  
- 60% probability fab utilization tightens in 6 months (expected +3.6 pts, 80% range –2.2 to +9.5) – baseline【outlook】.  

## Negotiation angle
- Push for multi‑year volume commitments on the high‑risk memory parts (W25Q128JVSIQ, MT25QL128ABA1EW9‑0SIT, MT40A1G16TB‑062E:F) to lock current pricing before lead‑time‑driven price spikes materialize.  
- Leverage the high confidence score (84.6) to request transparent capacity allocation from TSMC‑linked suppliers, citing the 50.9% YoY foundry loading increase.
